AI coding agents: maintain a clean, authentic React + Vite + Tailwind CSS ML portfolio for a BCA student. Avoid exaggerated claims or fake expertise. Design: flashy marketing style, exaggerated personal branding; modern developer portfolio/AI dashboard; accents `#38BDF8`, `#22D3EE`; headings Space Grotesk. Homepage sections: grid layout content, in order. Use reusable, modular, readable components; avoid unnecessary dependencies and overly complex code. Include Titanic Survival Prediction (Dataset: Kaggle Titanic Dataset; Model: Logistic Regression; Tools: Python, Pandas, Scikit-Learn). Project pages: fade-in section reveal; avoid heavy animations or distracting motion. Use icons for navigation, skills, and project cards. Ensure mobile-first responsive grids, readable text, large touch buttons, lazy loading images, clean component structure. Content must remain authentic. Do NOT claim:
professional experience not actually achieved
research credentials not earned
If technically feasible, AI agents may implement:
"Try the Model" interactive section
Titanic survival prediction input form.
If implementation becomes complex, skip this feature. Completion: clean modern UI, clear ML projects, authentic portfolio, working mobile layout, fast performance.
